channels.who: the model being scored (its structure IS the reference column)
channels.split_why: the reference column is the scored model's own output on whichever side of a split the molecule lands
channels.price: +0.2400 SD measured against +0.0848 SD read as agreement

channels.who: the design programs, through where they put the pair
channels.split_why: placement is a property of how the molecule was written, and it travels with the molecule into either side
channels.price: marginal +0.0250 against matched +0.0539; 71.2% of the gap predicted by beta*g

channels.who: whoever wrote the declared target, through helix depth
channels.split_why: depth is read off a target somebody declared and travels with the molecule

channels.who: the corpus builder, through the rule that selected the designs
channels.split_why: the selection rule decided which molecules exist to be split at all
channels.price: skill against the selecting score, Spearman -0.2455 [-0.37726, -0.09286]

channels.who: the model's authors, through decomposition and through training data
channels.split_why: the contrast is between models, not between molecules; a split reassigns molecules and leaves it untouched

channels.who: the objective the design loop was told to optimise (the model's own energy)
channels.split_why: a free energy is a property of the sequence, not of its relatedness to a training set

channels.who: the model's training set, through window overlap
channels.split_why: THE one channel a split is built to close: it is defined by similarity between a test molecule and what the model was trained on
channels.price: unexposed +0.21720 against exposed +0.13463; the thermodynamic control drops too (+0.13342 to +0.00115)

channels.who: the probe chemistry the depositors chose
channels.split_why: the chemistry is a property of the assay, not of any partition of molecules
channels.price: paired rank difference across the two chemistries [-0.0761, 0.2305], covering zero

unpriced.who: the experimenters, through WHICH pairs were given a compensatory mutant
unpriced.why: the corpus supplies the mutants; nothing in it says why those pairs and not others, and no arm of either paper prices it. Named in NM's Discussion and unpriced there.

a sequence can have been seen without its experimental label having been seen; an audit built from deposited measurements cannot separate that case. Named in NM's leakage scopebox and outside C7's reach.
